info.title: osucc
info.description: osu-cc launcher: launches osu! with DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS pointing at the hook deployed in the osu-cc data root. Never builds, never touches the install dir; the hook is installed and updated by the in-game updater plugin.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: osu-cc launcher: launch osu! with the startup hook from the osu-cc data root (never builds, never touches the install dir).

options.name: --osu-dir
options.description: Path to the osu! install directory.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print extra diagnostics while working. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Apply any staged update, then launch osu! with the deployed hook (no build).

commands.name: start
commands.description: Apply any staged update, then launch osu! with the deployed hook (same as run).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show resolved paths, deployed hook/plugin state and any staged update.
